headlines.title: Meta launches $35 billion stock offering to fund AI expansion
headlines.summary: A $95 billion equity raise is not a footnote — that's a tape-moving event. Meta flooding the market with new shares puts immediate pressure on its stock price and signals to the Street just how capital-hungry this AI buildout really is; Nvidia's $3B investment in Meta adds another wrinkle. This ripples across the whole AI infrastructure complex — cloud, chips, data centers — and raises the uncomfortable question Cramer already flagged: is this IPO/capital-raise wave about to drain the liquidity that's been fueling the bull run?

headlines.title: Fed expected to hold rates steady, but Warsh may point way to more hikes
headlines.summary: A hold is baked in — 93% of the Street expects no move — but the real trade here is what Warsh signals about the path forward. If the new Fed chair leans hawkish and hints at more hikes ahead, the long bond sells off and rate-sensitive tech multiples get another haircut right into a monster earnings week. This is the macro event that sets the tone for everything else on the calendar.

headlines.title: From Wall Street to Silicon Valley, Anthropic IPO poised to have massive 'trickle-down effect'
headlines.summary: Anthropic's S-1 is the AI sector's report card right now — a 15-fold revenue jump sounds great until you read the fine print: concentrated customers, massive compute bills flowing to Google and Amazon, and a governance structure that leaves public shareholders holding the bag. How this IPO prices and trades will set the sentiment dial for every AI name on the board; a stumble here could be the pin that pricks the whole AI valuation story.
